items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey did not practice for the second straight day due to rib injury, making it unlikely he plays Sunday vs Raiders.
items.why: Second consecutive DNP after Week 1 exit
items.implication: Downgrade McConkey; elevate other Chargers WRs
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/targets for Quentin Johnston and Tre Harris

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP second straight practice. Ja'Kobi Lane on IR (wrist). If Flowers out, Ravens WR hierarchy: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Moore.
items.implication: Bateman becomes primary flex/WR3 option; Andrews target bump

items.text: Nico Collins hurt hamstring in Wed practice (history of missing 5 games in 2024); DNP Thu; routes last week 37/42 dropbacks. MRI pending, status in jeopardy vs CIN despite not believed serious.
items.why: Hamstring pull + high route volume; Grade 1 but availability doubtful
items.implication: Monitor Friday; if OUT boost Houston WR2/3 and Schultz
items.opportunity: Hutchinson 29, Boutte 27, Noel 15 routes if Collins sits

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson 'ready to go' after full practices; unclear how much he eats into Rhamondre Stevenson but returns at perfect time with AJ Brown on IR and soft upcoming matchups (PIT/JAX/BUF etc pre-bye).
items.why: Self-declared ready + full participation; Pats need explosives
items.implication: Henderson volatile FLEX/handcuff; Stevenson still RB2 floor
items.opportunity: Explosive carries/routes vs Stevenson; goal-line TBD

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers DNP again Thursday due to last week's knee surgery; has yet to practice since procedure.
items.why: Meniscus trim recovery; hopes to practice but no work yet
items.implication: Michael Mayer fringe TE1 if Bowers sits; Jeanty unaffected full

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE Week 2 vs IND: 24% target share (tied team lead, 2nd-highest career) in Chiefs debut, 21/24 RB touches thru 3Q, 74% snaps. Indy just surrendered 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry. RB1 overall in range of outcomes.
items.implication: Must-start RB1; massive season ceiling if healthy
items.opportunity: High target share + carries + RZ potential

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE @ LAC: Utilization Score 99 in Kubiak debut (tied Bijan for league lead). 19% tgt share recent; 25+ touches in 3 of last 4. Full practice on ankle.
items.why: Elite util + volume; injury scare overreacted
items.implication: Strong RB1/2 start; Kubiak scheme boost

items.text: Week 2 waiver injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; AJ Brown=Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; De'Zhaun Stribling=Deebo Samuel; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller (reverse if Kamara in).
items.implication: Priority adds for depth/flex; reverse Kamara if active

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow limited participant second consecutive day with back injury.
items.implication: Monitor; Chase/Higgins/Brown usage if limited mobility

items.text: DeVonta Smith LOVE @ TEN: 27% tgt share + 13.7 aDOT (3 deep) Week 1. TEN allowed 85% catch rate/16 YPR to Jets WRs; 6th-most FPPG to WRs since last year. Bounceback.
items.opportunity: Deep targets + volume vs soft secondary

items.text: Justin Jefferson LOVE @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz Week 1; averages 93 rec yds/18 PPG in 6 career games with Wentz. Bears just allowed 10+ YPT to Carolina WRs.
items.why: Volume with Wentz + soft secondary matchup
items.implication: WR1 lock; bounce or continue elite
items.opportunity: High target share vs vulnerable defense

items.text: Travis Etienne HATE @ BAL (Kamara return squeezes role; underdog script). Marvin Harrison Jr HATE vs SEA (8% tgt share Week 1, 5th on team, 0 RZ; SEA tough on WRs).
Dalton Kincaid LOVE vs DET (69% routes highest since '24, 77% snaps; DET allowed 27 to TEs). Bucky Irving LOVE vs CLE (career-high 26% tgt, all RB RZ touches, out-routed Gainwell).
Colston Loveland 89% route participation Week 1 (highest TE); 0 pts but missed end-zone throw. Buy low if owner panics; Ben Johnson hand-picked.
items.why: Elite route share despite bad luck stats
items.implication: Hold/buy TE upside in Bears offense
